Privacy

Your task data should feel safe.

This plain-English policy explains what may be collected and what is not collected.

What we may collect

We may collect your name, email address, contact messages, beta feedback, and basic website usage information if analytics is enabled.

What we do not collect in the public demo

The public first-move demo runs locally in your browser. It does not need an account and should not send your task text to a server.

How task inputs may be used in the product

If you use a logged-in product version, task inputs may be used to create first moves, short steps, and session support. The product should avoid sharing personal task data with unrelated third parties.

Cookies and analytics

The website may use basic analytics to understand page visits, CTA clicks, and form usage. Analytics should not include private task text, names, messages, or sensitive personal content.

Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may use trusted tools for hosting, forms, analytics, and email if needed to operate the website.

Deletion requests

You can request deletion of contact messages or beta data by using the Contact page. Use the subject “Data deletion request.”
